newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr strengthens against U.S. dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr strengthens against U.S. dollar.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr firmed against the dollar on Monday from last week's rates, the National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) reported.
The bank quoted the birr at a mean rate of of 6.7010 to the dollar compared with 6.7810 last week.
It said that following a currency auction on July 12, the applicable rate for all transactions outside the auction in the July 14-20 period would be 6.7010 birr to the dollar.
The bank said it offered $20 million at the auction.

The highest bid rate offered at auction was 6.991 birr to the dollar and the lowest 6.437 birr. Bidders who offered rates of 6.701 birr and above per dollar won the full amount they tendered for, it added.
The bank posted the birr at a mean rate of 11.3715 to the pound from 11.4361 on Friday, and the birr traded at 0.058935 to one yen from 0.060099 last week.
